source: Traced on docs/aerial-reference/bharat-mandapam-satellite-z18-full.jpg (Esri z18, about 0.524 m per pixel), in its pixels; converted through satellite-reference.json.
status: Satellite trace, not a survey. Centrelines follow the visible carriageways; widths and medians are measured off the image to about 1 to 2 m; grade separation (flyovers, the underpass) is not modelled.
widthUnits: Venue world metres (the image's 0.524 ground metres per pixel is 0.553 world metres per pixel)

walkwaysSource: Internal network, 2026-10-19: centrelines of the user's colour-coded aerial (orange = service road, cyan = walkway), registered to the z18 image on the Hall 14, Hall 1 and Hall 6 roofs, thinned to centrelines, then each line shifted by up to 12 z18 px onto the paving it follows on docs/aerial-reference/bharat-mandapam-satellite-z19-venue.jpg. Widths are 0.8 x the painted band, clamped.
mainRoadsRecentred: 2026-10-20: Mathura Road and Bhairon Road (southern-frontage, eastern-frontage) recentred on the z19 photo: averaged cross-profiles of paving, outer edges across medians, smoothed over ~90 m and capped at 6 m; widths 28 and 25 m from the measured paved band. The colour guide was not used for these, because it sits 2 to 7 m off the photo here. Bhairon Marg (northern-road) already sits on its median and is unchanged.
outerRoadsFromGuide: 2026-10-20: roads marked fromGuide are red bands of the user's colour-coded aerial that no other road covered, thinned to centrelines and kept only where the z18 photo shows a road; candidates on the railway, on roofs, on lawns or duplicating an existing road were dropped. Ends join the nearest road within 30 m.
outerRoadsOnOsm: 2026-10-22: outer roads checked against the OSM context registered to the z18 image (scripts/build-venue-map-context.cjs). Roads whose centre sat more than ~5 m off the paving were recentred on the middle of their OSM carriageways (parallel ways only, offsets smoothed over ~50 m, capped at 20 m); ramps and lanes that did not follow the paving were retraced from their OSM way (fromOsm); roads that do not exist were removed. Widths stay measured off the image.
roadClasses: class: arterial = Mathura Road, Bhairon Marg, Ring Road and their carriageways, ramps and links; local = residential streets and avenues; service = service lanes and parking access. Colours the Color → Map scenery only.
surfacesSource: 2026-10-22: treeCover is the dark-green canopy of the z18 photo inside the old render-traced planting parcels (2G-R-B > 12, mean < 105, 2 m cells, closed and opened by one cell), minus roads, OSM and reference buildings, the railway and the property, cut into plain rings; trees are planted only there. surfaces are inside the property on the z19 photo: lawn = green (2G-R-B > 14), water = the dark fountain pond, parking = traced by hand where z19 shows parked rows, plaza = the rest of the open ground minus OSM/reference buildings. Surfaces show only in Color with the Map scenery.
